segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״הֲרֵי זֶה גִּיטִּךְ, עַל מְנָת שֶׁתִּתְּנִי לִי מָאתַיִם זוּז״ – הֲרֵי זוֹ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת, וְתִתֵּן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a husband says to his wife: «This is your bill of divorce on the condition that you will give me two hundred dinars,» then «she is divorced and must give» two hundred dinars in order to fulfill the condition of the bill of divorce.

segments.he: ״עַל מְנָת שֶׁתִּתְּנִי לִי מִיכָּן וְעַד שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם״ – אִם נָתְנָה לוֹ בְּתוֹךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם, מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת; וְאִם לָאו, אֵינָהּ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת.
segments.en: If a husband says to his wife: This is your bill of divorce «on the condition that you will give me» money «from now until» the conclusion of «thirty days, if she gives» the money «to him within thirty days she is divorced. And if not she is not divorced.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: מַעֲשֶׂה בְּצַיְדָּן, בְּאֶחָד שֶׁאָמַר לְאִשְׁתּוֹ: ״הֲרֵי זֶה גִּיטִּךְ, עַל מְנָת שֶׁתִּתְּנִי לִי אִיצְטְלִיתִי״, וְאָבְדָה אִיצְטְלִיתוֹ, וְאָמְרוּ חֲכָמִים: תִּתֵּן לוֹ אֶת דָּמֶיהָ.
segments.en: «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said:» There was «an incident in» the city of «Tzaidan involving one who said to his wife: This is your bill of divorce on the condition that you will give me my coat [itztaliti], and she lost his coat,» so that she could not give it to him. «And the Rabbis said» that «she must give him the value» of the coat, and by doing so she fulfills the condition and is divorced.
